name: North Tonawanda (United States)
description: White field with a green horizontal stripe charged with a yellow disc bearing a crossed axe and hammer in green, between NORTH TONAWANDA above and NEW YORK below in green.
history: North Tonawanda is a city in Niagara County, New York, on the Erie Canal. This flag was adopted in 1967; Flags of the World records that a contest begun in June 2024 produced a new flag, designed by Jeremy Sniatecki, unveiled on 8 July 2025.

features.role: disc with a crossed axe and hammer
words NORTH TONAWANDA and NEW YORK
